dialect.detail: IBM CICS/TS online program using channels and containers (CICS TS 3.1+ style), VSAM file access with READ/REWRITE, DFHRESP conditions

purpose.domain_detail: Quiz/survey answer tallying system - reads a question number and answer choice from an input container, reads a VSAM file record for that question, increments the appropriate answer counter, and rewrites the record
purpose.summary: RESTFI09 is a CICS online program that processes survey or quiz responses. It reads an input container containing a question number and answer choice (1, 2, or 3), reads the corresponding VSAM record (file MIMKK21B), increments the vote count for the selected answer, rewrites the record, and returns results via output containers including timestamp.

notable_features: EXEC CICS channels and containers (CICS TS 3.1+ feature)
VSAM READ with UPDATE and REWRITE
EXEC CICS ASKTIME / FORMATTIME for timestamp
EXEC CICS ABEND for error handling
Multiple PUT CONTAINER calls for output, error, RC, and date
verdict.notes: The filename MIMKK21V.cbl and VSAM file name MIMKK21B suggest this is part of a named application suite (MIMKK21). The program appears to be a RESTful-style CICS service (as noted in the header comment) for tallying answers to multiple-choice questions. Minor code quality issue: PERFORM PUT-TO-CONTAINER is called mid-flow without STOP RUN/RETURN, so execution falls through after error paths. No COPY statements used; all data defined inline.
